title: Ngeli ya KU-KU (Theme 7: Elimu ya mazingira)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows verbal nouns (kusoma, kuimba) are in KU-KU and take ku- in the singular and the plural.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Kupanda miti kunasaidia mazingira."

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kusoma ___napendeza." Kwa nini "a" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za KU-KU hupatana na ku-: kusoma kunapendeza. A- ni ya mtu mmoja.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kucheza ___nafurahisha." Kwa nini "u" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitenzi-jina hupatana na ku-, kama kinavyoanza: kucheza kunafurahisha.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Wingi wa "kusoma" ni ___." Kwa nini "makusoma" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za KU-KU hazina wingi tofauti. Kusoma hubaki kusoma.

misconceptions.ask: Kimilikishi kinapatana na nomino ipi hapa?
misconceptions.repair: Kitenzi-jina huchukua kw- katika kimilikishi: kuimba kwake.
